status: Reviewed team-source capture into private templates implemented; scoped Core/build and installed phone/tablet acceptance. Team-owned catalogs/runs and the full ranked Px goal remain open.

implementation.namespace: Advanced team task sources are classified by current/historical team custody. Portable shared root/child labels bypass personal catalog IDs/names/colors; children inherit the root label namespace. Supported legacy label lengths survive; opaque/unsafe/unsupported label data refuses capture explicitly.
implementation.opening: Transient, non-Codable capture binds full selected project/section/task records, relevant manual-order rows, workspace/account/backend session/origin and team access token. Relative offsets use the opening date; review never reacquires a replacement baseline.
implementation.review: Explicit private-copy explanation, complete workflow preview, editable name, Cancel and Save. Changed branches/records/access/session/account hide the preview and block Save. Unrelated tasks/projects and unrelated personal labels do not invalidate a wholly shared source.
implementation.save: Existing private owner-only template writer, one stable new template identity, no task creation or source edit. Independent Mac Undo registration. Existing fresh task/project/generation runs and portable export remain responsible for later use.
implementation.limits: Personal source capture keeps its direct save. Team source read permission is not team write authority; this stage adds neither team-owned template catalogs nor team run destinations.

coverage: shared root/child label namespace and immunity to personal catalogs
full raw-source conflicts even for excluded opaque/history data
unsupported shared label refusal without source changes
fresh private run identities, no team grant/history/ownership transfer
readable legacy shared label length beyond new-label adder limits

builds.iOS: Isolated arm64 Debug app and UI runner build-for-testing pass; final UI-test-only revision includes the existing source-change fixture flag.
builds.macOS: Independent isolated arm64 Debug app build passes with signing disabled; not installed Mac runtime acceptance.

native.scope: Exact reserved isolated synthetic team host, real Store/private cache and owner-template outbox. Network intercepted; no live hosted/Auth/Keychain acceptance. Source is one team project with a root and two embedded children.
cases: Label/scope review, Cancel leaves cache exact, Save creates exactly one private template and no tasks, relaunch retains it
Changed source pauses and hides preview before a command can be created
Changed access token pauses saving with no queued write
native.visualScope: Four standard-light phone/tablet preview/refusal images inspected; scrollable forms retain controls and readable source/portable labels. Not large-text/dark/contrast/spoken/Mac runtime proof.
